notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050273/0484b6c3a3656627e14902933f85f95e79ee2102.jpg

Hello,

In this patch, we are adressing some achievements and notifications issues.

Achievement Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where Hunger and Threat indicators could remain locked in the red state under specific conditions.
 Resolved an issue where the first Threat/Hunger reducing action after loading a save caused incorrect notifications, displaying an increase instead of a decrease.
 Resolved an issue where The Discipline achievement would not unlock on Steam.

UI/Notification Fixes:

 Resolved an issue preventing The Hunted achievement from unlocking.
 Resolved an issue where the Threat statistic would reset upon loading a save, making it harder to unlock Threat-related achievements (The Recklessness, The Irreverent, The Hunted).

Thank you for your support.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050273/0484b6c3a3656627e14902933f85f95e79ee2102.jpg

Hello,

In this patch, we've successfully fixed the achievement issue and updated some of the dialogue, here's the changelog:

 Achievements should now unlock properly! (Note: This does not apply retroactively to previously saved games.)     
 Minor dialogue updates: Adjusted several lines based on community feedback to improve clarity and immersion.    
 Minor updates to the credits.
 Feedback, suggestions, or bug reports? 
Share them with us on the Steam Community Hub — we’d love to hear from you!

Thank you for your support.

Enjoy the game!
